source_description_html:
The Pro Series Adventure-X jacket and jean is a musthave for all adventure riding. Designed with input from legendary Dakar Rally finisher Mick Extance, who knows what is needed to make the best jackets for adventure riding! An addition to the jacket and jean is the innovative and removable X-Liner – a singular lightweight lining which features the quilted thermal liner and the SinAqua waterproof membrane combined together; making this a great waterproof motorcycle jacket. This can be removed easily and stored in the rear jacket map pocket. This along with the superior levels of ventilation in the form of the fixed comfort mesh lining and multiple chest, arm, rear and leg vents ensure superb levels of air flow in and out of the jacket and jean, keeping you cool as you ride. This kit is ready to protect in the event of any impact and has a CE Certification Rating of AA and CE Level 2 with back protector and shoulder, elbow and knee armour along with a pocket for the hip armour and TPU shoulder cups. If that wasn’t enough, hardwearing MAX Zips are used throughout the jacket and there are stretch motion panels and adjustment points on the arm and waist to offer the most comfortable fit. From huge ventilation points to CE armour, the RST Adventure-X jacket and jean is everything you need a textile adventure motorbike combo to be and more!

source_description_html:
This is one of the best heated and waterproof gloves on the market! We have optimized the glove based on customer feedback all around, from improving heat distribution to more comfort and versatility in everyday life. The glove comes with improved TPU knuckle protection as well as memory foam elements for finger and thumb protection. In addition, the glove is made of extremely durable HTC fabric and features padded palms made of full grain leather with silicone grip coatings for extra grip even with padded fingers. The pre-curved fingers also feature stretch panels for added comfort and mobility. The Smart-Touch fabric on the index finger and thumb and the visor wiper on the index finger are ingenious and extremely useful features, thanks to which de does not have to stop so often. It also has a soft polyester lining and is equipped with a waterproof SinAqua lining to keep your hands dry. Adjustable hook-and-loop closures, elastic cuffs and one-hand closure pulls ensure a tight and secure fit. To improve ergonomics, the rubberized control knob and LED indicator have been repositioned and are now recessed into the glove. This allows the heater to be activated/deactivated while riding, and the three heat levels can be easily switched as needed. Red corresponds to the hottest setting, orange to the middle setting, and green to the coldest setting. The heating has been extended to cover the entire finger and the entire back of the hand. On top of that, the battery is housed in a waterproof pouch and also comes with a universal charging adapter. With up to four hours of continuous heating, the glove is perfect for riding in severe winter weather.

The Paragon 6 pants have been designed to provide more effective protection against wind and weather on the one hand and on the other hand to allow the highest possible comfort on the bike and when walking. Like the jacket, the pants have been revised to meet all weather conditions and have been equipped with the latest technologies. The Paragon 6 is made of ballistic reinforced MaxTex, which has a hydrophobic Durable Water Repellent (DWR) coating. For sweat absorption, it features the Quick-Dry mesh lining. Combined, the removable 300g lightweight quilted thermal lining and SinAqua Pro lining provide exceptional warmth, waterproofing and breathability. Hip and knee protectors offer protection in areas most prone to falls, while large stretch panels provide comfort and mobility. Front vents keep legs ventilated in wet conditions thanks to the SinAqua-Pro liner. Front vents allow air to flow in. At the same time, the vents can remain open even in the rain due to the protection provided by the SinAqua inner lining. Additional features include a Velcro waist adjuster and removable suspenders. Pockets and reflective elements add everyday utility and protection. It can be combined with all Paragon 6 jackets via the 360° zipper.

source_description_html:
ATTENTION - unrestricted use is associated with additional costs:
The jacket only operates with the In & box control module, which is installed in the back shell of the jacket. Further information can be found in the text below.
Democratising airbag technology was RST's single minded goal when they started developing theirs integrated airbag range a few years ago. The Axiom jacket realises this ambition - designed for the daily commuter who uses a bike as a mode of transport not pleasure and who ultimately, wants all the protection with no hassles when it comes to their kit. Made from heavy-duty MaxTex, the jacket features a breathable fixed SinAqua waterproof lining and a fixed mesh lining which, when all combined, offer fantastic levels of waterproofing and breathability. Added to this are the reflective styling details, waterproof cargo pockets and elasticated hook & loop waist adjusters to contour the jacket to the shape of the rider. The jacket features shoulder and elbow protectors, TPU shoulder cups and reflective panels for visibility and protection. Add in In&motion Airbag technology for enhanced protection and the Axiom becomes a no nonsense, three quarter length Airbag jacket that brings the highest level of safety to all riders. Use the 360° connection zip to connect to any RST pants.

Features:
  • Main Outer Material: MaxTex
  • Fixed SinAqua Waterproof Membrane
  • Fixed Mesh inner lining
  • Neoprene collar
  • RST premium zippers
  • Corespun polyester threads
  • Front intake zip vents and rear outlet zip vent
  • 360° connection zipper
  • Hook & Loop sleeve, cuff and mid waist Adjusters
  • 2 outer pockets and 1 inner pocket
  • Reflective details
Specifications:
  • Back protector: In&motion back protector EN1621-2 Level 1
  • Shoulder protector: EN1621-1 Level 1
  • Elbow protectors: EN1621-1 Level 1
  • Airbag: System In&motion
In&box system:
  • The In&box control module is not included in the delivery, but will be sent automatically after registration with the company In&Motion.
Purchase option:
  • Purchase of the In&box: 399 € / one time
  • On race tracks, the race mode must be activated on the race track (officially approved race tracks).
  • Continuous optimization: Free software updates
  • Mobile app (dashboard): Available for iOS and Android. With the mobile "My In&box" app you can call up the battery charge status, the connection status of your system and the updates (only via WiFi) with one click.
Leasing option:
  • Leasing the In&box € 120 / year or € 12 / month
  • Continuous optimization: Free software updates.
  • Mobile app (dashboard): Available for iOS and Android. With the mobile "My In&box" app you can call up the battery charge status, the connection status of your system and the updates (only via WiFi) with one click.
  • Without obligation: you no longer ride a motorcycle? You can end the tenancy and send your In&box back to In&motion.
  • Customer service in case of a problem: If you have a problem with your In&box, contact In&motion and you will receive a new In & box within 72 hours.
  • Purchase option: you can buy the In&box for € 99 after 3 consecutive years of rental.
  • The new In&box generation: After 3 consecutive rental years you can benefit from the new In&box generation.
Track Mode (optional):
  • 8 € / month or 25 € / year
  • Do you drive on the racetrack? Make sure your suit or jacket is compatible and enable the track mode through the mobile app before you start.
  • a credit card is required for this option
Contents:
  • 1x RST Axiom Airbag Motorcycle Textile Jacket
  • 1x In&box control module (is active for 48 hours after initial activation and must then be registered and activated separately by In&Motion, which incurs additional costs)
Due to the security regulations of the airlines, this article can only be shipped to countries within Europe!

ADDITIONAL PRODUCT INFORMATION

Material Upper: 100% Polyester, Lining: 100% Polyester

Even minor details have been taken care of to improve comfort and weather protection. The removable, padded neck warmer tucks under the helmet and protects the neck from wind and rain. The large waterproof storage and map pockets are extremely practical and protect keys and other valuables. The Paragon 6 is an ultimate rainy weather jacket! It can be combined with the Paragon 6 pants via the 360° zipper. The jacket is also available in a textile version without airbag.
